name: scry
description: SessionStart checks that tell an agent session the true state of the world and establish that repository Markdown is untrusted historical material. Also installs PreToolUse hooks that deny a tool call: one denies any dispatch that names no model — a subagent or workflow agent (a blank model silently inherits the session's, which is how a week of premium allowance can go in one session) and a metered agent CLI run through Bash (with no -m flag the CLI's own config default answers, which is how a month's budget went in one night) — and one denies a first attempt at an expensive Elixir force-rebuild. It also warns once, before it happens, when a headless `claude -p` run would bill the API account instead of the subscription. Plus an advisory on first contact with a large, actively-worked source file. Available on demand via /scry.
